Internal moves (accountClassTransfer, same-address dex sends, subAccountTransfer, internalTransfer) are not netted.

D1-c loss(e) = -qty*(p_recon - p_exec) - (catch-up slippage + catch-up fee), per plan §3 D1-c; does not add back the fee/slippage the original (now-skipped) t+δ trade would have paid — the formula as given only subtracts the catch-up leg's own friction, so loss(e) is the INCREMENTAL cost of deferring this one trade, not a full swap-accounting of both legs.
